name: Dray Sap Waterfall
summary: Walk the viewpoints over the wide Serepok sheet in Dak Sor, Krong No. The cascade is about 100 metres across and about 12 metres down, in primary forest, with Gia Long and Trinh Nu in the same cluster. It sits about 110 km from Gia Nghia, so skip it when a Ta Dung morning already has the day. The gate price is Check on arrival.
getThere: About 110 km from Gia Nghia, in Krong No
heroCaption: The wide sheet of Dray Sap, with forest along the cliff
bestMonths: May to October for a fuller cascade

notice.title: Not a same-morning add-on
notice.body: Dray Sap is about 110 km from Gia Nghia. Do not pair it with a Ta Dung boat morning.

body: Walk the viewpoints over the wide sheet. The cascade is about 100 metres across and about 12 metres down, in primary forest. Gia Long and Trinh Nu sit in the same cluster, in Dak Sor, Krong No. Give the site the middle of the day. How long you stay on the paths is Check on arrival.

The gate price is Check on arrival. The opening hour is Check on arrival. Read the board when you arrive. The mistake is treating the falls as a short hop after the lake. This is the Dak Sor cascade on the Serepok, not the Dray Nur fall on the Buon Ma Thuot side of the river.

figures.caption: The full width from the river, framed by the forest
figures.alt: Dray Sap waterfall across the Serepok, seen through trees on both sides

gettingThere: The eco-site is in Dak Sor, Krong No, about 110 km from Gia Nghia. Hire a car or a motorbike. The minutes are Check on arrival. Travelers who fly into Buon Ma Thuot often approach from that side of the Serepok. The kilometres from the airport to the gate are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Gia Nghia
legs.body: About 110 km by road. Hire a car or a motorbike. The minutes are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Buon Ma Thuot
legs.body: Buon Ma Thuot is the usual flight, then the road toward Krong No. Gia Nghia is about 125 km from Buon Ma Thuot, and also about 135 km. Those figures are the road between the two towns. The kilometres from the airport to the gate are Check on arrival.
